The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of NLP in combination with intentional sampling of longitudinal data can improve generalizability of EHR research and reduce bias in risk modeling.
EHR data can be used to create cohorts that resemble the community based cohorts that have traditionally been used for discovery, but with greater power and lower bias.
